integrity: A complete parameter-independent algebraic proof is accompanied by finite exact-field rank checks; numerical experiments are not relied on to infer arbitrary parameters. Originality comparisons include residual uncertainty for unindexed sources.
scientific_limitations: Only single source and sink, m parallel directed two-edge routes with no direct source-to-sink arc, complex primitive-root coefficients; no assertion about other network families or integer coefficients. Selected four-node low-order biparallel calculations already appear in the motivating paper.
title: Complete Mayer path homology and branch-permutation modules of nontransitive directed theta networks
